lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in roughly five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form anchor nodes containing the highest-intensity circular clusters.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible; the most prominent ridge runs through the center of the flank, characterized by a light-to-shadow gradient defining the upper boundary of the mid-lateral section.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or indentation is present on the leading edge apex of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher spatial density of smaller, lower-intensity spots compared to the macro-patterning on the lateral flank.
